UP Police Constable Result 2026 - Complete Details

UP Police Constable Result 2026. Candidates who appeared in the examination can now check their result and download the scorecard from the official website. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Application Fee

  • सामान्य (General) : 13,093
  • अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC) : 8,818
  • अनुसूचित जाति (SC) : 6,857
  • अनुसूचित जनजाति (ST) : 647
  • UP Police Constable : अभ्यर्थी को भारत के किसी मान्यता प्राप्त बोर्ड से 12वीं (इंटरमीडिएट) परीक्षा उत्तीर्ण होना चाहिए।
  • UR / OBC / SC : 168 सेमी
  • ST : 160 सेमी
  • UR / OBC / SC : 152 सेमी
  • ST : 147 सेमी

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
